title: Piercing Statue Duo #029 (데미스탯 · [데미스탯·P8 집중형·ebony·메이크업 요루바신부화장] ; [데미스탯·P25 집중형·루비색 유리·메이크업 인스타글램])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi statue portrait. TWO women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the thighs, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Yoruba Nigerian woman — rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a high top-knot bun. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge mixed-metal drop dangle hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide mixed-metal ear cuff, two smaller mixed-metal rings and a small mixed-metal stud at the top; two mixed-metal pieces in a row along the outer end of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a small mixed-metal ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small pearls set into the metal.
#1 Physique: A still-visible cinched waist beneath a full soft chest, wide curving hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque wood, solid deep black ebony wood, densely fine-grained, polished to a hard, glass-like satin sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult American woman — sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in elegant updo. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge silver clicker ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, three smaller silver rings, two thick silver bars and a small silver stud up to the top; one small silver stud sits in the right ear; four silver pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small silver rings pass through the left nostril and a thick silver septum ring hangs below the nose; a silver hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a silver snake-bite ring beside it and a small silver ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a silver Medusa stud sits above the lips; a silver labret stud and a small silver ring sit on the chin; three small silver studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal.
#2 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#2 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid transparent material, solid deep ruby-red cast glass, with slow internal swirls and a few tiny air bubbles, deepest crimson where thickest and pale rose at every thin edge, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Boundary for each woman: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is that material's own carved finish — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind them washed with two coloured lights from behind — a pale lilac on one side and a soft mint on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods every transparent body from behind, tinting it, while the opaque bodies block it completely and are lit by two large softboxes raking from either side. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
